analyst_view.overall: Early view: Stuttgart are 14th on seven points after losing 2-0 at Galatasaray, their first defeat of the phase, and they were without midfielder Angelo Stiller (adductor). Lille are 35th with one point after a 0-0 at Bodø/Glimt and need a win to keep any hope; Ethan Mbappé's three-match ban is now served. Stuttgart play at Inter on matchday 5, so this home game is their best chance of points.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I keep that: Stuttgart conceded only two in their first three league-phase games and Lille have scored just four in four. Lille's need to win could open the game late on.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. I lean slightly higher on Stuttgart's side: they should dominate the ball at home against a bottom-two team, with Leweling and Führich as wing-backs in their predicted line-up.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards. I leave it: Lille's discipline has been an issue (Mbappé's long ban), but that was one incident, and the referee has not been named yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.4 shots. I lean slightly higher: Stuttgart at home against a side with one point should have long spells of pressure, and Lille will have to push forward later.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.6 shots on target. I keep it: Stuttgart should create plenty, but Stiller, who usually controls their possession, was out with an adductor injury and his return date is unknown.
